customer_acme_ops: Hi team — since this morning's promotion to redwood-ptv7c we're seeing invalid JSON responses from structured_output (json_mode) on our orders endpoint. Repro below.

support_agent_maria: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl and the raw response you received (including chunk boundaries if streaming)?

customer_acme_ops: Here's the curl we used:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-ptv7c-quant","json_mode":true,"stream":true,"input":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Raw streamed chunks we captured (each line is a chunk):
```
{"order": {"id": 1234, "status": "shipped", "items": ["sku1",
"sku2"]}}
{"meta": {"latency_ms": 82}}
```
But in many calls the closing `]}}` is missing and the response ends like:
```
{"order": {"id": 1234, "status": "shipped", "items": ["sku1",
"sku2"
```
which causes our JSON parser to throw EOF errors.

eng_jamal: Hmm, interesting. Two quick checks: 1) does the full non-streaming response succeed? 2) which model tag exactly (you said redwood-ptv7c-quant)?

customer_acme_ops: Non-streaming (stream=false) returns a complete JSON every time. We're using tag `redwood-ptv7c-quant` promoted at 2026-03-15T08:12:00Z (deploy bot confirmed). Can share request-id on next failure.

deploy-bot: Promotion event: redwood-ptv7c-quant promoted from canary to staged at 2026-03-15T08:12Z. Canary traffic: 10% @08:12, 30% @08:20, 100% @08:45.

sre_sophie: @eng_jamal any chance a kernel or tokenizer change on the runtime could be emitting partial tokens for structural chars on boundary? If json_mode with streaming tries to flush mid-escape we can end up with unparseable fragments.

eng_jamal: That's my suspicion. Recent runtime change selected a new attention kernel for v7c that modifies tokenization buffer flush behavior under continuous-batching. It might be emitting chunks that split UTF-8 escape sequences or split right-brackets between chunks. We'll need raw chunk boundaries and the sequence of bytes. Customer, can you capture the raw chunk bytes (not reassembled) and a request-id? Also: please try setting header `X-Stream-Max-Chunk-Tokens: 64` or set stream=false as a workaround.

customer_acme_ops: Attaching small sample (request-id: rq_20260315_08_31_22):
chunks:
1) "{\"order\":{\"id\":1234,\"status\":\"shipped\",\"items\":[\"sku1\",\"sku2\"\n"
2) "\n"
3) ""  <-- empty chunk sometimes

Our parser sees the sequence and fails.

support_agent_maria: Thanks. Reproduced internally with the tag + streaming on. Non-streaming OK, streaming sometimes yields truncated structural tokens. Flagging to runtime team and filing SEV.

eng_jamal: Immediate mitigation: change streaming chunker to avoid splitting on characters `]`, `}`, `\"` when json_mode=true. Longer fix: ensure tokenizer flush respects structured-output token boundaries (requires runtime patch). I'll open a PR and attach patch notes. For now: rollback option is to pin customers to `redwood-ptv7b-stable` or set stream=false.

sre_sophie: Also add a temporary compatibility shim in the proxy to buffer until a complete JSON object is emitted when `json_mode=true` and `stream=true` — small latency cost but reduces parser breakage.

customer_acme_ops: We'll test with stream=false and try the proxy shim. If that fixes we'll keep pinned. Thanks, @maria, @jamal.

support_agent_maria: Action items: 1) eng_jamal open PR + hotfix. 2) sre_sophie PR for proxy shim. 3) Support to coordinate rollback if customer wants immediate. 4) Customer to test stream=false and confirm.

customer_acme_ops: Confirmed stream=false works. We'll pin to v7b for now and test hotfix in staging next week. :thumbsup:

support_agent_maria: Closing loop — created support ticket #SUP-2026-482. Reopen if you hit other regressions. :eyes:
